INDOMITABLESPIRE2-HYDRANGEA_TEA_PARTY.pa:
[color=#dee4c0]The clamor of the Spire fades into a sea of blooming [/color][blue]hydrangeas[/blue][color=#dee4c0]. You yawn. Surely there is a quiet corner here for a [/color][sine][color=#dee4c0]long, comfortable nap[/color][/sine][color=#dee4c0].

But in the pavilion among the flowers, your three sisters have already laid out tea and pastries.
[/color][blue]Illustrious[/blue][color=#dee4c0] waves with a gentle smile. [/color][gold]Victorious[/gold][color=#dee4c0] raises her teacup and calls your name. [/color][purple]Formidable[/purple][color=#dee4c0] sits perfectly upright, her gaze putting an end to any thoughts of slipping away.

Your plans to slack off will have to wait. Whose invitation will you accept?[/color]

[color=#dee4c0]You settle beside Illustrious. She pours you a cup of tea, and its warm fragrance eases the tension from your shoulders.

[/color][blue]“May the light of love and peace always protect you, my dear sister.”[/blue][color=#dee4c0]

She places two potions beside your saucer and invites you to take one. Of course she has thought of your safety on the road, too.[/color]

[color=#dee4c0]You have barely sat down when Victorious claps you on the shoulder and slides a cup of her special blend across the table. Her enthusiasm is almost blinding. Even your drowsiness begins to fade.

[/color][gold]“However strong the enemy, set sail with victory in your heart! Cheers!”[/gold][color=#dee4c0]

After clinking cups, she produces two potions. It seems you must choose something from her collection to help you on your way.[/color]

[color=#dee4c0]You quietly take the seat opposite Formidable. She lifts her teacup with a gracious nod, as though you had never considered sneaking away.

[/color][purple]“Now that you are here, do enjoy this little moment of peace. And mind your manners.”[/purple][color=#dee4c0]

Two potions stand beside the pastries. One brings dangerous flames to mind; the other promises [/color][sine][color=#dee4c0]deep, dreamless sleep[/color][/sine][color=#dee4c0]. Formidable nudges them toward you and waits for your choice.[/color]

[color=#dee4c0]The teacups are empty. All too soon, it is time to leave.

You tuck away your gifts and cast a longing glance at the hydrangeas. Such a lovely place for a nap... but the Spire still awaits.

With a lazy stretch and your sisters' blessings, you reluctantly continue your journey.
[/color][sine][color=#dee4c0]You can always sleep when you get back...[/color][/sine]
